_note: Daytime backfill (opencrawl/backfill.py): back-to-back GitHub Actions runs inside the day window until subject profiles stop filling. Set enabled to true to start it; delete state/backfill.json's done flag (or the file) to start over. Set window.timezone to your own (an IANA name such as America/Denver). month_minutes_cap counts every run's Actions minutes this month (month_minutes_before adds runs from before counting began). Size it to your plan's included minutes plus any Actions budget you set, leaving room for the nightly runs.
